mainEntity.name: Does Space BQS publish fixed prices?

acceptedAnswer.text: No fixed prices are listed on this page. Contact Space BQS with your team and workflow requirements to discuss licensing.

mainEntity.name: What information should I provide for a quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: Share your organization type, team size, approximate survey volume, and the delivery, ROB, or debunkering workflows you use. You can provide these details in the demo request form.
Contact the Space BQS team to discuss whether a pilot is available and what its setup and evaluation scope would be.
